howto.name: Upload an .xlsx file
howto.text: Drop an Excel workbook up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts each sheet to a PDF page
howto.text: Cell values, formulas (as computed), formatting, and column widths are preserved. Each worksheet becomes one or more pages depending on content size.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The output PDF has one section per worksheet.

faq.a: No — only computed values appear. The formulas themselves are not included (PDF has no formula concept).
Charts render as static images. Embedded images are preserved at their original size.

faq.q: How does it handle very wide sheets?
faq.a: Wide sheets paginate across multiple PDF pages, with column headers repeated on each.
